mods.name: Arcana Novum
mods.description: A Server-Side magic mod that adds various Arcana Items to your server!

releases.notes:
This are mostly bug fixes that I needed to get out for my upcoming project. A 1.21.5 version will happen at some point, how soon depends on whether I migrate my new project to it or not.

- Tracking and Ensnarement Arrows are now required for Overly Equipped Archer
- Fixed many typos
- Greater Blindness now has a vanilla replacement of Blindness (#22)
- Fixed a Crash Bug with the Vengeance Totem

mods.name: Arcana Novum
mods.description: A Server-Side magic mod that adds various Arcana Items to your server!

releases.notes:
The Spear of Tenbrous now has a lightning effect as it travels
The Levitation Harness is once again trimmable
Added new Transmutation Recipes
Fixed the Nul Memento not marking itself as inactive after cancelling a deallocation attempt
Fixed Photonic Arrows, Detonation Arrows, Storm Arrows, and a thrown Spear of Tenbrous from giving proper kill credit to the player (and not adding to Soulstones)
Fixed a glitch that allowed a Soulstone to be farmed for massive amounts of Arcana XP
